WITH tbl_email AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   Row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY tmdate DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_phoneemail
                       WHERE    phoneoremail = 'EMAIL'
                       AND      preferredflag = 'Y'
                       AND      accountid IS NOT NULL
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) A
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_phone AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   Row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY tmdate DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_phoneemail
                       WHERE    phoneoremail = 'PHONE'
                       AND      preferredflag = 'Y'
                       AND      accountid IS NOT NULL
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) A
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_address AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   Row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY addressid DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_address
                       WHERE    preferredaddress = 'Y'
                       AND      end_date = '2099-12-31'
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) A
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_miscellaneousinfo AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY miscellaneousid DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_miscellaneousinfo
                       WHERE    type = 'Risk_Type'
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) a
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_corpmiscellaneousinfo AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY corp_misc_id DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_corpmiscellaneousinfo
                       WHERE    type = 'Risk_Type'
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) a
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_consent AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY miscellaneousid DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_miscellaneousinfo
                       WHERE    type = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE'
					   AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) a
       WHERE  rn = 1), tbl_occupation AS
(
       SELECT *
       FROM   (
                       SELECT   row_number() OVER (partition BY orgkey ORDER BY miscellaneousid DESC) AS rn,
                                *
                       FROM     eds.crm_miscellaneousinfo
                       WHERE    type = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
                       AND 		CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date AND scd_end_date) a
       WHERE  rn = 1)
SELECT 		COUNT(*)
			FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS CUST
			LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_GENDER_DIM AS MV_GENDER
				ON MV_GENDER.[VALUE] = CUST.GENDER
				AND MV_GENDER.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_GENDER.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_GENDER.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('R', 'P')
			LEFT JOIN TBL_EMAIL AS EMAIL
				ON CUST.ORGKEY = EMAIL.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = EMAIL.BANK_ID
			LEFT JOIN TBL_PHONE AS PHONE
				ON CUST.ORGKEY = PHONE.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = PHONE.BANK_ID
			LEFT JOIN TBL_ADDRESS AS ADDRESS
				ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = ADDRESS.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = ADDRESS.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC AS DEMOGRAPHIC
			--	ON CUST.ORGKEY = DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID
			--	AND DEMOGRAPHIC.MARITAL_STATUS <> ''
			--	AND DEMOGRAPHIC.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE)  BETWEEN DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_Start_Date AND DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_End_Date
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_MARITAL_STATUS_DIM AS MV_MARITAL_STATUS
			--	ON MV_MARITAL_STATUS.[VALUE] = DEMOGRAPHIC.MARITAL_STATUS
			--	AND MV_MARITAL_STATUS.BANK_ID = DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_MARITAL_STATUS.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_MARITAL_STATUS.SCD_End_Date
			--	AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('R', 'P')
            LEFT JOIN TBL_OCCUPATION AS OCCUPATION
                    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = OCCUPATION.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = OCCUPATION.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = OCCUPATION.BANK_ID
			LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION_DIM AS MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION
				ON MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION.[VALUE] = OCCUPATION.STRTEXT2
				AND MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION.BANK_ID = OCCUPATION.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('R', 'P')
			LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPORATE AS CORPORATE
				ON CORPORATE.CORP_KEY = CUST.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = CORPORATE.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE)  BETWEEN CORPORATE.SCD_Start_Date AND CORPORATE.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('C', 'B')
			LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM AS MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM
				ON MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM.[VALUE] = CORPORATE.LINE_OF_ACTIVITY_DESC
				AND MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM.BANK_ID = CORPORATE.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('C', 'B')
			LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM AS MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM
				ON MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.[VALUE] = CORPORATE.SECTOR
				AND MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.BANK_ID = CORPORATE.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('C', 'B')
			LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM AS MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM
				ON MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.[VALUE] = CORPORATE.SUBSECTOR
				AND MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.BANK_ID = CORPORATE.BANK_ID
				AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_SUB_SECTOR_CODE_DIM.SCD_End_Date
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('C', 'B')				
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL AS FINANCIAL
			--	ON CUST.ORGKEY = FINANCIAL.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = FINANCIAL.BANK_ID
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN FINANCIAL.SCD_Start_Date AND FINANCIAL.SCD_End_Date
			--	AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('C', 'B')
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_AMLKYC AS AMLKYC
			--	ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = AMLKYC.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = AMLKYC.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = AMLKYC.BANK_ID
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN AMLKYC.SCD_Start_Date AND AMLKYC.SCD_End_Date
			LEFT JOIN TBL_MISCELLANEOUSINFO AS RISKRATING
				ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = RISKRATING.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = RISKRATING.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = RISKRATING.BANK_ID
			--LEFT JOIN TBL_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO AS CORPRISKRATING
			--	ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = CORPRISKRATING.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = CORPRISKRATING.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = CORPRISKRATING.BANK_ID
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.ATM_CLIENT AS ATM_CLIENT
			--	ON CUST.ORGKEY = ATM_CLIENT.CLT_CIF_NUMBER
			--	AND CUST.BANK_ID = ATM_CLIENT.BNK_CODE
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN ATM_CLIENT.SCD_Start_Date AND ATM_CLIENT.SCD_End_Date
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB AS MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
			--	ON CUST.ORGKEY = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.CIF_NO
			--	AND CUST.BANK_ID = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.BNK_CODE
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_Start_Date AND MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_End_Date
			--LEFT JOIN EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION AS RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION				
			--	ON CUST.ORGKEY = RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.CUST_ID
			--	AND CUST.BANK_ID = RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.BNK_CODE
			--	AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE) BETWEEN RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_Start_Date AND RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_End_Date
			LEFT JOIN TBL_CONSENT AS CONSENT
				ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = CONSENT.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = CONSENT.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = CONSENT.BANK_ID
				AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN ('R', 'P')
             LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM AS MV_CITY
                ON MV_CITY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.CITY
                AND MV_CITY.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
                AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_CITY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_CITY.SCD_End_Date
            LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM AS MV_STATE
                ON MV_STATE.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
                AND MV_STATE.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
                AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_STATE.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_STATE.SCD_End_Date
            LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_COUNTRY_DIM AS MV_COUNTRY
                ON MV_COUNTRY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
                AND MV_COUNTRY.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
                AND CAST('2023-09-05' AS DATE)  BETWEEN MV_COUNTRY.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_COUNTRY.SCD_End_Date
            WHERE CUST.H = 'D';
